lines.text: Jehu tells the people he will serve Baal a lot and orders every servant of Baal summoned for a great sacrifice.
All the servants of Baal come and fill the temple, and Jehu has the keeper of the wardrobe bring out lamps for them.
Jehu stations eighty men outside, and after the burnt offering he orders the guards and officers to go in and kill them.
Jehu's men burn the sacred pillar and make the temple a latrine, and Jehu tears down the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

wrong_details.wrong: Jehu tears down the golden calves at Bethel and Dan
wrong_details.true: Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan

lines.text: Hazael defeats Israel throughout its territory, and Jehu is buried in Samaria after reigning twenty-eight years, with his son Jehoahaz reigning next.
